categories.name: Chest
categories.description: Chest training primarily targets the pectoralis major and minor. It is essential for upper body pushing strength and creates a balanced, powerful physique.
categories.howTo: Focus on 'controlled' movements. On pushing exercises, keep your shoulder blades tucked back and down. Don't lock your elbows at the top to keep tension on the muscles.
categories.benefit: Improved pushing power, better posture, and increased metabolic rate through large muscle activation.

categories.name: Back
categories.description: Back training involves the latissimus dorsi, rhomboids, and trapezius. A strong back is the foundation for almost every other lift and protects your spine.
categories.howTo: Think about 'pulling with your elbows' rather than your hands. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the peak of the movement for maximum contraction.
categories.benefit: Creates the 'V-taper' look, improves spinal health, and balances out the front of your body to prevent rounded shoulders.

categories.name: Legs
categories.description: Leg day covers the quads, hamstrings, and glutes. Since these are the largest muscles in the body, training them burns the most calories and releases the most growth hormones.
categories.howTo: Keep your feet flat on the floor. On squats, ensure your knees stay in line with your toes and don't cave inward. Maintain a neutral spine throughout.
categories.benefit: Massive functional strength for daily life, explosive power, and the highest calorie burn of any workout type.
